title: Joseph and Potiphar's Wife

questions.question: Who bought Joseph in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:1 (ESV): "Joseph had been brought down to Egypt, and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh...bought him."

questions.question: Did the LORD bless Joseph in Potiphar's house?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:2: "The LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man."

questions.question: What did Potiphar's wife want Joseph to do?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:7: "His master's wife cast her eyes on Joseph and said, 'Lie with me.'"

questions.question: What happened to Joseph after the false accusation?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:20: "Joseph's master took him and put him into the prison."

questions.question: Was the LORD with Joseph in prison?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:21: "But the LORD was with Joseph and showed him steadfast love."

questions.question: What role did Joseph have in Potiphar's house?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:4-5: "He made him overseer of his house and put him in charge of all that he had."

questions.question: What did Joseph leave behind when he fled from Potiphar's wife?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:12: "She caught him by his garment, saying, 'Lie with me.' But he left his garment in her hand and fled."

questions.question: What reason did Joseph give for refusing Potiphar's wife?
options: It would be a sin against God
He did not find her attractive
questions.correctAnswer: It would be a sin against God
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:9: "How then can I do this great wickedness and sin against God?"

questions.question: What did the keeper of the prison do with Joseph?
options: Put all prisoners under Joseph's care
questions.correctAnswer: Put all prisoners under Joseph's care
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:22: "The keeper of the prison put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners."

questions.question: What did Potiphar's wife accuse Joseph of?
options: Trying to force himself on her
questions.correctAnswer: Trying to force himself on her
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:14: "She called to the men of her household and said...He came in to me to lie with me."

questions.question: What detail shows Potiphar trusted Joseph completely?
options: He did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate
questions.correctAnswer: He did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:6: "He left all that he had in Joseph's charge, and because of him he had no concern about anything but the food he ate."

questions.question: How often did Potiphar's wife tempt Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:10: "And as she spoke to Joseph day after day, he would not listen to her."

questions.question: What type of prison was Joseph placed in?
options: The place where the king's prisoners were confined
questions.correctAnswer: The place where the king's prisoners were confined
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:20: "He put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were confined."

questions.question: What was Potiphar's official title?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:1: "Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian."

questions.question: What phrase is repeated to emphasize God's presence with Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 39:2, 21, 23: "The LORD was with Joseph" is repeated throughout the chapter.

key_verse_text: The LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man.
